latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Photo Video Maker Arabic — Turn Photos into Arabic Videos:

- Allows users to turn JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WebP images into 1080p Arabic-captioned slideshow videos.
- Cloud-based processing with easy upload and automated setup—no local installation required.
- Session and authentication handled transparently; guides users through token generation if needed.
- Supports exporting videos as MP4, plus project management, status tracking, and credits check.
- Error handling for common scenarios (token expiry, file issues, export limitations, etc.).
- Designed for Arabic-speaking content creators on social media.
